paite: Huai lai in a-unaute uh Judate dem a nakpitak a kikouna, mite leh azite ua kipan ahong omta hi.
heading: Migentheite Nuaisiahna
english: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.

paite: Kou, ka tapate leh ka tanute uh, tampi ka hi ua: "Ka nek ua ka hintheihna ding un, buh-le-bal hon pia un," chi pawl ahong om uhi.
english: For there were some who said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”

paite: "Ka loute uh, ka grephuante uh, ka innte uh ka zuak ua; kial ziak in, buh-le-bal hon pia un," chi kuate hiam leng a-om uhi.
english: There were also some who said, “We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”

paite: "Ka loute uh leh ka grephuante ua dit ding in kumpipa siah ding in sum ka leitawi uh, chimi khenkhat leng a-om uhi.
english: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.

paite: Hinapi in ka sa uh ka unaute uh sa bang ahi a, ka tate uh lah amau tate bang: Ngai un, ka tapate uh leh ka tanute uh sikhate hi ding in tanna ah ka pi ua, ka tanute uh lak a akhente tanna a pi in a-om khin man hial ua, panpih theihna ka nei kei ua; midangte'n lah ka loute uh leh ka grephuante uh anei ngal ua," chi in.
english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring our sons and our daughters into bondage to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. It is also not in our power to help it, because other men have our fields and our vineyards.”

paite: Huchi a akikouna uleh hiai thute ka zak in ka heh mahmah hi.
english: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

paite: Huchih lai in ka kingaihtuah a, miliante leh vaihawmte ka sal a, akiang uah, "Michih in a-unau lak ah apung na phut uh," ka chi hi. Huchi in amaute demna kikhawmpi thupi ka nei hi.
english: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.

paite: Akiang uah, "Khovel mite kiang a zuak a omsa, i unau Judate i theih bang un i tanta ua; nou na unaute uh zuak in, i lak ua khot a om ding uh ahi maw?" ka chi hi. Amau adai dide ua, thu khat leng anei kei uhi.
english: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found not a word to say.

paite: "Na thilhih uh ahoih kei; i melmate khovel mite'n hon simmohna ziak un, i Pathian laudan siam a na om ding uh hilou hia? ka chih behlap hi.
english: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the nations, our enemies?

paite: Huchi mah bang in, 'ka unaute leh ka sikhate leh ke'n amau kiang ah sum leh buh-le-bal ka leitawisak uhi. K'on ngen ahi, apung omsak kei ni.'
english: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.

paite: 'Pe nawn un, ka hon ngen ahi, akiang uah, tuni mahmah in, aloute uh, agrephuante uh, a-olive huante uleh a-innte uh, asum uh aseh zakhatna leng, buh-le-bal, uain,' leh sathau, amau a kipan na phutkhia uhi," ka chi hi.
english: Please restore to them, even today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”

paite: Huchi in amau, "Ka pe nawn ding ua, amau a kipan bangmah ka phut kei ding uh; huchibang in ka hih ding ua, na chih mah bang in," achi uhi. Ke'n siampute ka sam a, akichiamna uh ka la a, huchi a hiai thuchiam bang a ahihna ding un.
english: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them. We will do so, even as you say.” Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they would do according to this promise.

paite: Ke'n leng ka pheipi ka vuangsak a, "Hiai thuchiam bawl lou peuhmah, a-inn a kipan, anasepna a kipan Pathian in hichibang in vuangsak hen; hichibangtak a vuankhiak ahi ding a, ahawm ding," ka chi hi. Huan khawmpite tengteng in, "Amen, TOUPA phat in om hen," achi uhi. Huchi in mite'n hiai thuchiam dungzui in ahih uhi.
english: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even may he be shaken out and emptied like this.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh. The people did according to this promise.

paite: Huai lou in Judah gam a a-ukpipa ding ua seh a ka om lai a kipan, kumpipa Artaksarses akum sawmnihna leh akum sawmthum-le-nihna chiang, huai bel, kum sawm-le-nih ahi a, kei leh ka unaute'n ukpipa tanghou ka ne kei uhi.
heading: Nehemiah Angmasial Louhna
english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.

paite: Himahleh kei ma a ukpipa masate mite tung a mohsak theih ahi ua, amau a kipan in tanghou leh uain ala uh, dangka shekel sawmli sim louh in; ahi, asikhate uh nangawn in mite tung ah vai ahawm uhi. Himahleh ke'n Pathian ka kihtak ziak in huchibang in ka hih kei hi.
english: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people, but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.

paite: Ahi, huai lou leng hiai kulhbaang nasepna ah ka pang nilouh a, gam himhim leng i lei kei uh: ka sikhate tengteng huai lam ah nasepna ah kaihkhawm in a-om uhi.
english: Yes, I also continued in the work of this wall. We didn’t buy any land. All my servants were gathered there to the work.

paite: Huai ban ah ka dohkan ah Judate leh vaihawmte lak a mi za-le-sawmnga, i kim i vel ua om khovel mite lak a pan i kiang ua hong paite chih louh, a-om uhi.
english: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.

paite: Ni khat a ding a bawlkholhsa bawngtal khat leh belam hoih ngenta guk ahi ua; vasate leng kei dia bawlkholhsa in a-om ua, huan ni sawm sung a khatvei uain chi chih a kipan koih hoih: hinapi in hiai mite tung a tanna agik ziak in, ukpipa tanghou hiaite tengteng ziak in ka phut kei hi.
english: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep. Also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine. Yet for all this, I didn’t demand the governor’s pay, because the bondage was heavy on this people.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, hoihna ding in, hiai mite a dia ka hih tengteng kei lam hon theigige in.
english: Remember me, my God, for all the good that I have done for this people.
